scenarios.title: A spell with its buyback cost paid returns to hand as it resolves
decisions: A casts Searing Touch targeting Fugitive Wizard, paying the buyback cost {4}, tapping all five Mountains.

variants.label: buyback_paid
variants.expected: Fugitive Wizard (1/1) takes 1 damage and moves to B's graveyard. Searing Touch returns to A's hand.

variants.label: buyback_not_paid
variants.delta: A does not pay the buyback cost and taps one Mountain only.
variants.expected: Fugitive Wizard dies. Searing Touch moves to A's graveyard.

variants.label: countered
variants.delta: B responds with Counterspell, tapping both Islands.
variants.expected: Searing Touch is countered and moves to A's graveyard, not to A's hand. Fugitive Wizard survives undamaged.

variants.label: fizzled
variants.delta: B responds with Unsummon on Fugitive Wizard, tapping one Island.
variants.expected: Fugitive Wizard returns to B's hand. Searing Touch has no legal target, fizzles and moves to A's graveyard, not to A's hand.
